title: The Idle Golem
text: An iron guardian stands in a ruined square, rusted still in mid-stride, one fist raised. Moss grows in its joints. A word is carved on its brow in an old tongue; change the word, the stories say, and it might serve a new master.

options.label: The wisest changes the word on its brow, hoping to make it serve a new master.

outcomes.text: It turns and kneels before them. For the rest of the road it walks at your side like a wall of iron.
It turns and remembers its orders. You are not among those it was told to spare.

options.label: The strongest breaks it up for iron before anyone else gets ideas.

outcomes.text: It yields a great deal of iron without resisting, which is somehow worse. Its eyes follow every blow.

options.label: Leave it be. Some guardians are better left at rest.

outcomes.text: As you leave, its head grinds round to follow you.
